messages:
maria: Heads-up — backing out of a few console PRs because the helm chart bump in runtime broke a dev path. Need a quick approval sweep so we can re-land with the patched chart. PRs: runtime#4021, sdk#1187, console#904.

jess: Which chart change caused it? I saw a values key rename yesterday but didn't dig in. :thinking_face:

maria: runtime team renamed `worker.replicas` -> `workers.count` in chart values.yaml. Console + SDK still render `worker.replicas` in templates so helm deploy fails in staging.

ryan: Ah, I remember that PR. I flagged it for docs update but missed the template usages. Oops.

kevin: Quick fix options: 1) revert runtime#4021, 2) patch console+sdk templates to read fallback `workers.count` or `worker.replicas`, 3) add compatibility alias in helm chart. Which do we want for minimal disruption?

maria: Prefer patching console+sdk (option 2) so runtime behavior stays stable. Changes are tiny: 2 lines in each repo. But need approvals from SDK owners and console owners.

jess: I'm +1 to patch templates. I can review console#904 today if someone posts the PR link.

maria: console#904 is posted — https://git.redwood/runtime/console/pull/904 (internal). Tests are green locally but CI flaked once. Please prioritize review; staging deploy is currently blocked.

infra-bot: CI update: staging helm deploy failed at 2026-02-11T14:22:03Z — "failed to parse values: unknown key 'worker.replicas'".

ryan: sdk#1187 is also open with the fallback logic (template: `{{ default .Values.workers.count .Values.worker.replicas }}`) — link: https://git.redwood/runtime/sdk/pull/1187. I can add changelog and owner tag.

kevin: If SDK owner review is the blocker, @sara — can you take a look when you have a minute? This is low-risk.

sara: On it. I can review sdk#1187 in ~45m. If it's tiny, we can merge and cut a patch release.

maria: Excellent. After merges: plan is to re-run helm deploy to staging, smoke test the console flows, then let runtime re-run its canary. If anything fails we'll revert.

jess: Reviewing console#904 now — left one nits comment about logging but approve for the compatibility change itself. :thumbsup:

sara: sdk#1187 approved and merged. I bumped the patch version in Chart.yaml locally so SDK package manager picks it up.

maria: console#904 merged after jess' approval. Re-running staging deploy now. infra-bot, kick staging helm deploy when ready?

infra-bot: Triggered staging deploy (run id: deploy-20260211-17). Will post logs to #eng-ops when complete.

maria: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: (1) runtime team — please add a short note in the release PR about value renames so owners can update templates next time; (2) eng-platform — let's add a quick CI check to detect undefined values in templates across repos. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

kevin: Agreed. I'll file the CI detection ticket and loop in infra.

ryan: Thanks for the fast turnaround. If anything else pops up in post-deploy smoke tests I'll ping here.

maria: Closing the loop — staging deploy succeeded, smoke tests pass, canary looks healthy. Reopen here if any rollback needed. :tada:
